provider.name: Species+
provider.organization_type: global species taxonomy, CITES, CMS, EU wildlife-trade legislation, quota, suspension, reservation, legal-reference, API, and download infrastructure
provider.description: Species+ consolidates taxonomic and legal information relevant to international wildlife trade and conservation. It links taxon concepts to CITES appendices and annotations, CMS listings, EU wildlife-trade annexes and measures, export quotas, trade suspensions, reservations, geographic entities, references, APIs, and downloadable datasets.
institutional_context: CITES Secretariat and official CITES data sources
National authorities, taxonomic specialists, conservation organizations, and legal-data providers

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Species+ documentation, organization, taxonomy, CITES, CMS, EU legislation, quotas, suspensions, reservations, annotations, parties, geography, references, API documentation, downloads, schemas, editorial workflows, data quality, licenses, citations, software, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Species+, UNEP-WCMC, CITES, CMS, the European Commission, official legal texts, party notifications, source taxonomies, and cited authorities remain authoritative for listings, measures, identifiers, dates, interpretations, rights, versions, and contacts.

Separate taxonomic facts from official legal texts, editorial interpretations, reference metadata, API output, software, and third-party sources.

Preserve taxon and legislation IDs, convention, appendix or annex, party, date, annotation, quota or suspension details, source document, citation, access date, release version, license URI, and provenance.
Do not treat Species+ as a substitute for authoritative legal texts or competent-authority advice.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
Species+ routes, API versions, authentication, legal-data fields, taxonomic sources, download formats, schemas, and licensing may change; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every taxon concept, legal record, quota, suspension, reservation, reference, API result, or download row when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store credentials, API keys, tokens, passwords, cookies, private editorial notes, unpublished legal submissions, or session identifiers.
Species+ is a consolidated information service and not a substitute for official legal texts, competent authorities, or professional legal advice.

Always preserve taxon concept ID, accepted-name ID, scientific name, authorship, rank, classification, taxonomy source and version, convention, appendix or annex, party, population, annotation, effective date, quota, suspension, reservation, source legal instrument, reference ID, geographic codes, API and release versions, citation, rights, source URL, and provenance.
